title: EnvironmentSpec
description: Agent-authored recipe to build a target in Docker, run it isolated, drive one exploit request, and let a nonce oracle confirm the vulnerability.

dockerfile.description: A complete Dockerfile that builds and (via CMD/ENTRYPOINT) starts the target app listening on app_port.

app_port.description: TCP port the app listens on inside the container.

ready_path.description: HTTP path polled to decide the app is up (default "/").

exploit.description: The single request that triggers the vulnerability. Its path and/or body MUST contain the literal {{NONCE}} placeholder.

kind.description: reflected_nonce: the nonce appears in the exploit response body. log_nonce: the nonce appears in the app's stdout/stderr logs.

rationale.description: Why observing the nonce here proves the specific vulnerability.
